D: A clumsy younger brother keeps wrecking his older brother's campaign for governor of Washington.
P: Serve the snacks when the campaign hits the road.
S: Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry, the snack at every rally. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into strips and wrap 24 cocktail franks.
Crisp red apple slices with peanut butter for dipping. Slice 4 red apples and serve with 200g peanut butter for dipping.
M: Salmon fillets baked with lemon and dill, cabin food. Lay 4 salmon fillets on foil with lemon slices, dill and butter, wrap and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.
W: Warm apple crumble with cream, a small-town fundraiser dessert. Toss 5 sliced apples with 60g sugar and cinnamon.
K: Strong brewed coffee with milk, to get through the campaign.

s.how: Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into strips and wrap 24 cocktail franks. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with sauce.
Slice 4 red apples and serve with 200g peanut butter for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Lay 4 salmon fillets on foil with lemon slices, dill and butter, wrap and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Serve with 600g boiled potatoes.

w.how: Toss 5 sliced apples with 60g sugar and cinnamon. Rub 100g butter into 120g flour, 60g oats and 100g brown sugar, scatter over and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a plunger and serve with milk. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
